info.title: VMS Phase 1 API contract
info.description: Approved simplified Phase 1 target: Bearer-only login/current-user, manually assigned single roles and fixed permissions. Stored session lifecycle and account/role writes are deferred. Existing application source is inventoried separately; this contract does not claim it is implemented.

BusinessId.description: D95: canonical decimal PostgreSQL INTEGER ID, 1 through 2147483647. Not a booking code or service ID.

Version.description: D97: positive PostgreSQL INTEGER conflict version. Exhaustion rejects mutation; never wrap/reset.

StartTime.description: Start only, Asia/Makassar. Must be in future on creation/schedule edits; end may exceed 16:00.

Email.description: One ASCII mailbox, no display-name/list/header input; trimmed, normalized per D82. Validate local/domain syntax and lengths.

Password.description: New password: >=15 code points AND <=72 UTF-8 bytes; bcrypt, no truncation/prehash.

ExistingPassword.description: Verify existing credential; new-password minimum is not imposed on current-password/login verification.

Reference.description: UUID request/submission/upload reference, distinct from a business ID.

Credential.description: Manual eight-digit code or opaque QR. Admission and checkout have different eligibility; D96 permits the QR consumed on successful check-in for checkout after admission expiry, unless revoked.

x-phase1.storage: Browser memory only; reload/expiry requires login. No persistent browser storage or token URL.
x-phase1.logout: Local token/user/private-cache clearing only; no logout HTTP endpoint and no per-token revocation claim. Copies remain usable until expiry while the account is active.
x-phase1.currentAuthority: Read current active employee, exactly one assigned fixed role and active PA official assignments on every protected request; repeat resource/assignment checks in write transactions. JWT role/permission claims and browser hints are never authority.
x-phase1.manualAdministration: Provision accounts with encoded bcrypt credentials and exactly one role_pegawai row; initial Super Admin is assigned the same way. PA assignments use pegawai_pejabat. Existing multiple-role accounts need deliberate manual selection before Phase 1 login; never pick/union silently.
x-phase1.employeeUI: Employee directory/detail are read-only; account creation/editing, role tags, assignment editing and role-policy UI are deferred.
x-phase1.permissionSource: Fixed backend mapping from the existing frontend role vocabulary, with roles/audit-only administration removed from Phase 1; database policy graph is not read or exposed.
basicsRetained: Password hashing and generic credential failures
Input validation, basic login throttling and existing public/staff request budgets
HTTPS for non-loopback deployment; explicit browser-origin policy
Ordinary/restricted privacy boundaries and public code/email proof
